sql:
WITH ord AS (SELECT * FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00'), fl AS (SELECT f.market_ticker, sum(f.quantity) q FROM fills f JOIN ord o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id GROUP BY 1), snapF AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, COALESCE(quantity_fp,quantity::numeric) qty, realized_pnl FROM positions WHERE market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM ord) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC), today AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl FROM positions WHERE captured_at >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND realized_pnl IS NOT NULL ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC), committed AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM ord WHERE status IN ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial','filled'))
SELECT 'A1_breaker_portfolio_today' k, to_char(COALESCE(sum(realized_pnl),0),'FM990.0000')||' vs -5.00 (n='||count(*)::text||')' v FROM today
UNION ALL SELECT 'A2_F_exch_realized_since_arm', to_char(COALESCE(sum(s.realized_pnl),0),'FM990.0000')||' settled='||count(*)::text FROM fl JOIN snapF s USING (market_ticker) WHERE s.qty=0 AND s.realized_pnl IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'B_live_open_by_cap_rule', count(*)::text||' vs bound 40' FROM committed c LEFT JOIN snapF s USING (market_ticker) WHERE s.qty IS NULL OR abs(s.qty)>0.01
UNION ALL SELECT 'C_fill_rate', (SELECT count(*) FROM fl)::text||' filled / '||(SELECT count(DISTINCT market_ticker) FROM ord)::text||' ordered'
UNION ALL SELECT 'D_orders_'||COALESCE(status,'?'), count(*)::text||' last='||to_char(max(created_at),'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM ord GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL SELECT 'E_last_fill', to_char(max(f.filled_at),'MM-DD HH24:MI')||' fills24h='||sum(CASE WHEN f.filled_at > now()-interval '24 hours' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::text FROM fills f JOIN ord o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'F_integrity_err', e.kind||' '||COALESCE(x.key,'?')||' '||to_char(e.detected_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM experiment_integrity_events e LEFT JOIN experiments x ON x.id=e.experiment_id WHERE e.severity='error' AND e.resolved_at IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'G_last_scan', to_char(max(created_at),'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')||' cycles2h='||count(*)::text FROM system_events WHERE component='mmsell_scan' AND created_at > now()-interval '2 hours'
UNION ALL SELECT 'H_twin_papertrades', to_char(sum(pnl),'FM990.0000')||' n='||count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00'
UNION ALL SELECT 'I_E_open', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT o2.market_ticker FROM live_orders o2 WHERE o2.strategy='Emmsell10' AND o2.action='buy') e2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, COALESCE(quantity_fp,quantity::numeric) qty FROM positions ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) s2 USING (market_ticker) WHERE s2.qty IS NOT NULL AND abs(s2.qty)>0.01
ORDER BY 1
